entryPointReview: The regression creates a source-valid initialized game using the actual startup, canonical room/keeper creation, and canonical add_damage writer. It calls the exported pay_for_damage action once through its real default behavior, retaining actual first-slot-zero five-entry ushops. The actual zap_dig production caller is the reviewed normal caller that records canonical damage and awaits pay_for_damage. This is a narrow runtime regression, not source certification or a claim that unrelated getcad/relocation helper gaps are closed.

functions.name: pay_for_damage
functions.sourceReview: Reviewed whole C shk.c:pay_for_damage against the JS implementation and changed only the inShop predicate to test the first zero-terminated ushops slot, matching C. Kept all existing parent behavior, ordering, defaults, and helper calls; no helper/caller edits.

callers.source: Actual exported67185 default call with genuine canonical add_damage record qualifies parent branch.
Normal lateral wall/door source caller records actual add_damage and awaits pay_for_damage; no public route gate for coherent initialized before-call state.
